scope: Pinned Astro 5 build and editor toolchain for the fully static Smart Control site

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable: the repository has no define:vars usage and accepts no visitor-authored script data.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Build-time only; production is static HTML with no Astro server runtime.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: A fixed release requires a coordinated Astro/Tailwind/Vite migration; keep the tested compatibility pin until that unit passes all gates.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable: the site has no server islands or server:defer directives.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Build-time only; no Astro server is deployed.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: Accept temporarily under the coordinated toolchain migration plan.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable: generated attribute names are repository-authored and visitor input is not rendered.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: Accept temporarily rather than bypass the tested compatibility pin with a major upgrade.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable: generated attribute names are repository-authored and visitor input is not rendered.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable: the repository does not use transition:* directive values on hydrated islands.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Build-time static generation plus the repository-authored ClientRouter bundle.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: Accept temporarily; browser regression remains mandatory for a coordinated upgrade.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable from untrusted data: transition metadata is repository-authored and the site accepts no visitor content.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Static pages with a repository-authored ClientRouter bundle; no server rendering.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: Accept temporarily; validate ClientRouter navigation during the coordinated upgrade.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable: production does not execute Astro request handling or consume Host headers.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Build-time only; the generated 404 page is served as a static file.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: No deployed Astro server exists; accept until the pinned trio can move together.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable from untrusted data: slot names are fixed in repository source and no visitor content is rendered.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: Accept temporarily under the coordinated toolchain migration plan.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable in production; the advisory requires a Windows development server.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Local development only; production is static and the supported CI/runtime line is Linux Node 22.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: The available npm remedy replaces the pinned Astro major; do not force it independently.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable from visitor input; only reviewed repository images enter the build.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: The npm fix target changes the Astro major; accept until the coordinated migration passes image and route regression.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable: the site does not use astro:assets, <Image>/<Picture> or getImage, and the repository contains no AVIF input; images ship as pre-built WebP files from public/.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Build-time only; production is static HTML with no Astro server runtime or image endpoint.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: The fixed release is Astro 7; accept until the pinned Astro/Tailwind/Vite trio is migrated as one tested unit.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable: astro.config.mjs sets no base path, and the site has no middleware, server routes or authorization logic.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Build-time static generation only; no Astro request handling is deployed.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: Accept temporarily under the coordinated toolchain migration plan.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable from visitor input: the Astro image service is unused, and the maintainer scripts that call sharp read only repository-committed PNG/SVG files, never HEIF/AVIF.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Maintainer scripts and build tooling only; no image processing runs in production.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: The npm fix target changes the Astro major; accept until the coordinated migration passes image and route regression.

acceptedAdvisories.reachability: Not reachable from untrusted input: the only SVG rasterised by sharp is the repository-authored template in scripts/generate-social-cards.mjs, run manually by maintainers.
acceptedAdvisories.exposure: Maintainer scripts and build tooling only; no image processing runs in production.
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: The npm fix target changes the Astro major; accept until the coordinated migration passes image and route regression.
